metadata.protocol: repl-from-stdin NDJSON: Initialize, Evaluate, GetSeed, ReplShift; one process with isolated initialization per case
metadata.policy: Go follows the TypeScript primary output, exact diagnostic and source reference, debug order, RNG, current/next registers and internal trace. Actual Rust outcomes, call traces, draws and final REPL shift are saved as independent comparison evidence.

cases.name: assignment
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=x'=7 }
cases.reason: A write changes only the next register.

cases.name: assignment-overwrite
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=all { x'=1, x'=2 } }
cases.reason: A later write to the same primed variable replaces the earlier write.

cases.name: assignment-rhs-error
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=all { x'=1, x'=1/0 } }
cases.reason: A failing RHS leaves an earlier next-state assignment in place.

cases.name: uninitialized-current
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=x==0 }
cases.reason: A discovered but unset current variable reports QNT502.

cases.name: assignment-current-read
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(all { x'=x+1, x'=x+2 }) }
cases.reason: Assignments in one step both read the same current state.

cases.name: all-empty
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=actionAll() }
cases.reason: An empty action conjunction succeeds without changing state.

cases.name: all-false-first
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(all { false, x'=1/0 }) }
cases.reason: A disabled action stops before evaluating later actions.

cases.name: all-false-rollback
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(all { x'=9, false, 1/0==0 }) }
cases.reason: A false action rolls the next register back and suppresses later errors.

cases.name: all-nested-rollback
cases.source: module M { var x:int var y:int action init=all{x'=0,y'=0} run result=init.then(all { x'=1, all { y'=2, false } }) }
cases.reason: Nested false conjunctions restore their own and their enclosing next-state snapshots.

cases.name: all-error-keeps-write
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(all { x'=9, 1/0==0 }) }
cases.reason: An error returns immediately without rolling preceding writes back.

cases.name: all-retains-before-snapshot
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then({ val before=x'=8; before and all { x'=9, false } }) }
cases.expression: init.then({ val before=x'=8; before and all { x'=9, false } })
cases.reason: Rollback preserves a next-state assignment made before entering the conjunction.

cases.reason: A single disabled choice restores the original pending state.

cases.name: any-retries-disabled
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(any { all { x'=9, false }, x'=7 }) }
cases.reason: Disabled alternatives roll their writes back before the enabled alternative is selected.

cases.name: any-all-disabled

cases.expression: init.then({ val before=x'=8; before and any { all { x'=9, false }, false } })
cases.reason: Choice exhaustion preserves pending writes that preceded the choice.

cases.name: then-second-error
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=(x'=1).then(x'=1/0) }
cases.reason: An error in the second action retains the already committed first state.

cases.name: then-three-states

cases.reason: Each successful first action commits one state; the last write remains pending.

cases.reason: A shift clears a variable that has no assignment in the intervening step.

cases.name: reps-zero
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=0.reps(i=>x'=1/0) }
cases.reason: Zero repetitions skip the callback and return true.

cases.name: reps-negative
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=(-1).reps(i=>x'=1/0) }
cases.reason: A negative repetition count performs no iterations.

cases.name: reps-one
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(1.reps(i=>x'=x+i+1)) }
cases.reason: One iteration produces a pending write without a final loop shift.

cases.name: reps-three
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(3.reps(i=>x'=x+i+1)) }
cases.reason: Repetitions pass zero-based indices and shift between, but not after, iterations.

cases.name: reps-disabled-second
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(3.reps(i=>all { x'=x+1, i!=1 })) }
cases.reason: A disabled callback reports its one-based iteration and keeps preceding committed states.

cases.name: reps-error-second
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(3.reps(i=>if(i==1) x'=1/0 else x'=x+1)) }
cases.reason: A callback error stops repetition without an extra shift.

cases.name: reps-count-error
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=(1/0).reps(i=>x'=2^(-1)) }
cases.reason: The repetition count is evaluated before creating or invoking the callback.

cases.name: reps-cached-local
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then({ val snapshot=q::debug("snapshot",x); 3.reps(i=>x'=snapshot+1) }) }
cases.reason: Scoped value caches clear between repetition states.

cases.name: cached-value-within-state
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then(x'=cached+cached+1) }
cases.reason: A top-level value is evaluated once per state even when referenced twice.

cases.name: cached-value-after-shift
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=init.then((x'=cached+cached+1).then(x'=cached+cached+1)) }
cases.reason: A successful then clears a cached state-dependent value before the next action.

cases.name: cached-action-val
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) val write=x'=q::debug("write",x+1) run result=init.then(all { write, write }) }
cases.reason: A value-qualified assignment result is cached within the current state.

analysisErrors.message: val operators may only read state variables, but operator `write` updates variables 'x'. Use action instead.

cases.name: uncached-action-def
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) action write=x'=q::debug("write",x+1) run result=init.then(all { write, write }) }
cases.reason: An action-qualified definition executes on every reference.

cases.name: expect-success
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=(x'=1).expect(x==1) }
cases.reason: A successful expectation restores pending writes and drops the temporary trace entry.

cases.name: expect-false-action

cases.name: expect-false-condition

cases.name: expect-then
cases.source: module M { var x:int action init=x'=0 action step=x'=x+1 val cached=q::debug("cached",x) run result=(x'=1).expect(x==1).then(x'=x+1) }
